name: Rocky Mountain Ecodharma Retreat Center
technique: Silent Insight Meditation retreats in nature, with group and solo sitting and walking meditation, dharma talks, and teacher meetings
teacherAccess: Rotating guest teachers, many trained through Spirit Rock/IMS retreat teacher programs, lead each retreat with daily dharma talks and individual teacher meetings.
retreatOptions: Mostly week-long silent retreats (6-7 nights), plus shorter weekend/long-weekend gatherings (3-4 nights) and occasional daylong events.
about: Rocky Mountain Ecodharma Retreat Center (RMERC) is a nonprofit retreat center on 180 acres of forest and meadow in Ward, Colorado, about 45 minutes northwest of Boulder. It hosts its own calendar of silent, teacher-led Insight Meditation retreats that combine traditional sitting and walking practice with an explicit focus on ecological awareness and connection to the natural world. Guests stay on-site in a rustic lodge (single rooms, shared rooms, and a nook) or in camping/glamping/RV spots, with most programs running for several days to a full week under noble silence. RMERC operates on a low-cost, dana-based model: program fees cover only center expenses (food and lodging), while teachers are supported separately through voluntary donations, and scholarships are available for those with financial need.
schedule: Seasonal program, roughly May through November, with an annually published calendar of retreats led by different visiting teachers; most retreats run Monday afternoon to Sunday afternoon.
cost: Program price (food and lodging) is set to cover only center costs, varies by lodging type (camping/shared/single room), with an ~10% early-bird discount and separate voluntary dana for teachers; need-based scholarships available.

pricePerDay.notes: Derived from the 'Touching the Earth' retreat (Aug 10-16, 2026, 6 nights): program price $660-$1080 including food and lodging, divided by 6 nights; range reflects camping/shared/single-room lodging tiers.

foodNotes: Meals are vegetarian and may include eggs or dairy; vegan and gluten-free options are available, and common allergies can usually be accommodated.
workNotes: Light shared 'yogi jobs' (meal prep/cleanup, bathrooms, tea bar) are assigned to participants during the retreat; not a heavy work-exchange program.
